summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K reporting a periodic aggregation of press releases including multiple daily “Transaction in own shares” announcements (Exhibits 1,6,10,14,16,17,18,21,24,25,27,28,29) and a dedicated “Share Buyback Programme” update (Exhibit 26). These share repurchases are the filings’ only substantive event beyond routine managerial disclosures, AGM results, and a CFO appointment (Exhibit 11). The buyback has no fixed expiration; BAT is returning capital directly to shareholders through open-market repurchases, a form of capital return. This is a discrete capital allocation activity. Watch for buyback pace and potential completion or suspension based on cash flow or regulatory changes.
